document_info.file_name: 49.2016_Will Asia Pulp and Paper default on its-zero deforestation- commitment_OKI_Mill_Report.pdf

extracted_stakeholders.name: Asia Pulp & Paper (APP)
extracted_stakeholders.role: Largest pulp and paper producer in Indonesia and China, implementing zero deforestation commitments.

extracted_stakeholders.name: Sinar Mas Group
extracted_stakeholders.role: Parent conglomerate of APP, involved in pulp and paper production and managing forestry concessions.

extracted_stakeholders.name: PT OKI Pulp & Paper Mills
extracted_stakeholders.role: Subsidiary of APP responsible for building a mega-scale pulp mill in South Sumatra, Indonesia.

extracted_stakeholders.name: The Forest Trust (TFT)
extracted_stakeholders.role: Conducted growth and yield assessments for APP’s plantations.

extracted_stakeholders.name: Greenpeace
extracted_stakeholders.role: Endorsed APP’s sustainability commitments and suspended its campaign against APP.

extracted_stakeholders.name: Indonesian Government
extracted_stakeholders.role: Issued licenses and tax holidays for plantation development and oversees environmental regulations.

extracted_stakeholders.name: Communities in South Sumatra
extracted_stakeholders.role: Local communities affected by plantation operations, some involved in disputes over land claims.

extracted_stakeholders.name: China Development Bank
extracted_stakeholders.role: Provided significant financing for the OKI mill project.

extracted_factors.Label: Zero Deforestation Commitment
extracted_factors.Description: APP's commitment to end clearing of natural forests, affecting its supply chain and plantation management.

extracted_factors.Label: Peatland Subsidence and Flooding
extracted_factors.Description: The degradation of peatlands leading to lowered plantation productivity and increased environmental costs.

extracted_factors.Label: High Material Risks from Fires
extracted_factors.Description: Fires in 2015 caused substantial damage to APP plantations and have persistent risks due to climate conditions.

extracted_factors.Label: Government Support and Regulation
extracted_factors.Description: Government incentives like tax holidays and land concessions that support and regulate pulp industry expansion.

extracted_factors.Label: Community Land Conflicts
extracted_factors.Description: Ongoing disputes between APP plantations and local communities over land ownership and rights.

extracted_factors.Label: Projected Shortfall of Plantation Wood
extracted_factors.Description: APP faces potential wood supply shortfalls due to insufficient plantation productivity to meet fiber demands.

extracted_factors.Label: Expansion of Pulp Production Capacity
extracted_factors.Description: APP’s plans to potentially expand OKI mill capacity, affecting fiber demand and environmental impacts.
